input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, address, role. The platform provides capabilities for custom reactive authentication manager, user exception handler, custom reactive user details. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage address records, so that I can track and organize address data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
